title: North-West Frontier Province Local Government Second Amendment Act 2006

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Local Government Second Amendment Act 2006
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 2006
ACT II OF 2006
North-West
Frontier Province Local Government (Second Amendment) Act 2006
An Act
further to amend the North-West Frontier
Province Local Government
Ordinance, 2001
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 16th
February, 2006]
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the North-West Frontier Province Local Government (Second
Amendment) Act, 2006.
(2)
It shall come into force at once.

sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Local Government Second Amendment Act 2006

Frontier Province Local Government Ordinance, 2001 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No.XIV of 2001), hereinafter
referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 42, in subsection (4), the words
"through a secret ballot" appearing at the end shall be deleted.
